dedupe_keys.name: nist ur5 robot position degradation and controller measurements

description: NIST provides measurements of UR 5 robot arm position degradation for industrial robot health assessment. Nominal tool-centre positions are compared with positions measured by a NIST seven-dimensional measurement system. Controller-level signals describe joint positions, velocities, currents, accelerations, torques and temperatures under different payloads, speeds and thermal conditions. The page lists CSV measurements collected at 125 Hz, plus spreadsheet headers and calculated positional deviations. Coverage is the NIST robot experiment, including half/full speed, 1.6/4.5 lb payloads and cold-start cases; observation dates are not stated. The provider explicitly links the data to industrial prognostics and validation of health-monitoring methods, supporting condition monitoring. The page is marked no longer updated, so its route is public but ongoing maintenance is not assumed. Dataset licence and reuse charges are not stated. A limitation is that calibration accuracy, missing values and actual time-series contents were not checked. Related NIST publications are listed; no article, spreadsheet or CSV body was obtained.
